learning.title: Hide graft's rewritten wiring files with assume-unchanged before the first /deliver review in a worktree
learning.trigger: A new worktree runs graft, which rewrites five tracked files: .claude/helpers/graft-hooks.cjs, .claude/helpers/graft-statusline.cjs, .cursor/hooks.json, .cursor/hooks/graft-hooks.cjs and .github/copilot-instructions.md.
learning.mistake: A slice review was recorded while those files were modified. The /deliver contract revision covers the tracked working tree, and phase-complete needs a clean tracked tree, so the valid approval could not complete the phase. Hiding the files afterwards changed the revision and made the approval stale, which cost another full review.
learning.rule: In every new worktree, before the first review: save `git diff` of the five files to a backup patch outside the repo, then run `git update-index --assume-unchanged` on them. Never stage or commit them. Undo with `--no-assume-unchanged` before the worktree is removed. Never edit a reviewer record to match a new revision; run a fresh review instead.

verification.requirement: `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no` prints nothing before the first review, and `git ls-files -v` shows `h` for the five files.
